messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete: inference-service:v7.3 deployed to canary. Quick-smoke + golden-eval hooks enabled. Dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/rollouts/3845671234
rachel: running golden-rerank checks now (50 queries from eval-set A). ETA ~2m.
tom: first pass: 50 queries -> rerank quality regression alert triggered. metric: MRR dropped from 0.842 -> 0.796 (regression threshold 0.03). Not network errors, just ordering shift.
lina: paste sample (sanitized):
```
Query id=G-17
expected top: doc_42, doc_7, doc_3
observed top: doc_7, doc_42, doc_3
score deltas: doc_42 -0.18, doc_7 +0.12
```
eval-bot: Eval summary: golden-rerank A: baseline v7.2 MRR=0.842, v7.3 canary MRR=0.796, delta=-0.046 (alerts fired). More details: https://evals/internal/3876/golden-a
rachel: interesting. this looks like a model scoring shift, possibly due to recent tokenization/embedding changes in v7.3. any recent changes called out in the release notes?
tom: changelog mentions "embedding normalization tweak" and "reranker sampling seed fix" in v7.3. that seed fix could change stochastic sampling but shouldn't affect deterministic rerank unless beam or scoring changed.
lina: propose immediate actions: 1) hold ramp (auto-hold) for quality regression, 2) run expanded golden set (500 queries) to confirm signal, 3) run ablation canary with reranker locked to v7.2 scoring binary on v7.3 runtime to isolate (if possible), 4) if regression persists, pin rerank route (/v1/rerank) to v7.2 for customers until we diagnose.
rachel: +1. also notify product that a user-visible ranking metric regressed for gold-set A. add a release note blurb: "investigating rerank metric delta on golden-set A; hold in canary."
eval-bot: Kicking off expanded eval: `evalctl run --suite golden-a --count 500 --target canary`
tom: expanded results streaming: halfway in, delta holding ~-0.045 across samples. seems consistent.
lina: trying the ablation test: `runtimectl set reranker.override_binary=v7.2 --scope=canary` (non-disruptive toggle).
eval-bot: Ablation run complete: rerank MRR with v7.2 binary on v7.3 runtime -> 0.840 (near baseline). This narrows issue to reranker binary change in v7.3.
rachel: good detective work. Plan: keep rollout on hold, revert reranker binary for canary (or pin rerank route to v7.2), open regression ticket RG-712 with priority P1, and prepare a small hotfix that restores v7.2 reranker behavior in v7.3. Also prepare customer-facing note in case heavy-rerank customers notice.
tom: created RG-712 and linked ablation logs. command to pin route if needed: `routerctl pin --route "/v1/rerank" --variant v7.2 --region global --reason "postdeploy-rerank-regression"`
lina: temporary mitigation: applying reranker override to canary: `runtimectl set reranker.override_binary=v7.2 --scope=canary` (done). monitoring now.
eval-bot: re-run golden-a 100 runs after override -> MRR=0.841, delta within noise.
rachel: decision: keep rollout held. engineering will prepare a patch for the reranker binary discrepancy. if patch ready and validated, we'll resume rollout. product: drafting a changelog note and flagging affected customers.
deploy-bot: Canary policy: auto-hold engaged for quality regression (golden-rerank alert). Rollout paused pending RG-712 resolution. Telemetry and eval artifacts: https://telemetry/internal/archives/3845671234
rachel: TL;DR: hold rollout; reranker binary change in v7.3 caused deterministic rerank shift vs v7.2; applied override to canary to restore baseline; RG-712 opened. will follow up with patch ETA."
